name: Cross-Asset Carry Tilt
description: Ranks the full asset universe by ex-ante carry (expected return from holding with flat prices) and equal-weights the top_n high-carry assets, zeroing low-carry assets. Bonds (VUTY) have the highest carry (yield-to-maturity); equities have moderate carry (dividend yield); precious metals (SGLN, SSLN) have negative carry (storage costs). Implements Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen & Vrugt (2018) carry factor in long-only ETF form.
